newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's EDP considers Telecel stake.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's EDP considers Telecel stake.

text.p: Electricity company EDP-Electricidade de Portugal is considering buying a 20 percent stake in Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel if the conditions are right, EDP President Antonio Almeida said.
"We have the option to buy 20 percent of the capital of Telecel," Almeida told Reuters. "We have no obligation to buy a single share," he added.
He said EDP would begin talks with the potential seller, U.S. group AirTouch Communications in January. AirTouch recently raised its stake in the Portuguese operator to 51 percent.
He said EDP would only consider buying the stake if the price was below the 34 billion escudos mentioned in the media.
The sale of a 39 percent stake in Telecel-Comunicacoes Pessoais, one of the biggest flotations in Portuguese history, was heavily oversubscribed and netted 60.8 billion escudos.
The price fixed in the flotation of Telecel, one of two mobile phone operators in Portugal, was 7,950 escudos per share.
Telecel shares closed at 9,700 escudos, up 170, in volume of 158,990 shares on Lisbon bourse on Friday.
